name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the required goal. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) matches the 'do not drop the key while the door is closed until it has been opened once' ban, since key_lost is the drop-while-closed event and the ban ends at the first door_open. The machine rejects a closed-door drop and reaches its final state only after the box is picked up.

texts: Pick up the designated box in the other room.
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: a key_lost event may not occur before door_open has become true.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&!key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u3
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u3, target_picked_up) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&!key_lost&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&!target_picked_up, u2) -> -10
(u0, !door_open&key_lost&target_picked_up, u2) -> -10
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u3, target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
